is_anopheles.evidence: Studies Anopheles gambiae s.l. (An. gambiae, An. coluzzii, and An. arabiensis) in Togo (page 1, 6).

reports_target_markers.evidence: Reports genotyping of kdr L1014F, kdr L1014S, and ace-1 G119S (pages 1, 3, 8, 9).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Provides complete genotype counts (RR/RS/SS) and sample sizes per site, species, and year in Table 3 (L1014F), Table 5 (L1014S), and Table 6 (ace-1 G119S).

african_field_population.evidence: Larvae of An. gambiae s.l. were collected from field sites in Baguida, Kovié, and Kolokopé, Togo and reared to adults (F0) (page 2).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary research article presenting original field survey, bioassay, and genotyping data.

sub_country_location.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected from three specific localities in Togo with coordinates: Baguida (06°09′47″N, 01°19′05″E), Kovié (06°34′38″N, 01°11′47″E), and Kolokopé (07°47′59″N, 01°18′00″E) (pages 2, 7).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Collections were conducted during June-July in 2012, 2013, and 2016, and results are reported broken down by single collection year (pages 2, 7-9).

duplicate_risk.evidence: Routine field surveys conducted by the authors in Togo across 2012, 2013, and 2016.

supplement.evidence: All necessary genotype counts, frequencies, sample sizes, and bioassay summaries are provided in the main text and tables (Tables 1-6).

assessment.summary: This study monitored insecticide resistance and resistance mechanisms in An. gambiae s.l. across three agricultural localities in Togo (Baguida, Kovié, Kolokopé) during 2012, 2013, and 2016. Standard WHO susceptibility bioassays showed widespread resistance to pyrethroids, DDT, and carbamates. Complete genotype counts and allele frequencies for Vgsc L1014F, Vgsc L1014S, and Ace-1 G119S are provided across An. gambiae, An. coluzzii, and An. arabiensis.
